- **The lane question the ruling left to triage (`6108492902`): one PR.**
  - Five positions, about 100–200 lines of text, and one invariant ("every sender-facing surface teaches the timestamped form"). Split into three lanes' PRs, the grep in the done-when stays false until the last one lands, and #22826 waits on all three.
  - The PR is Tier H in any case (the skill), so the maintainer's APPROVED review lands it once rather than once per lane.
- **Claimant: the `domain:skills` seat,** because the governed position (`skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md`) decides how the PR lands. It declares the other paths on their seat posts under the exception path:
  - `packages/lint/src/rule-explanations.ts` and `validate-flow-trigger-readiness.ts` on #6017;
  - `examples/app-showcase/…/flows/index.ts` and `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/automation.json` on the devx seat post.
- **Why p2:** it gates #22826, which closes the replay window on inbound hooks. That is #22805's grade.
- ⛔ The outbound contract (`webhooks.mdx` §6.2), `signHttpBody`, the flow `http` node and the messaging outbox stay as published, as the ruling says.
- **Done when:** as filed. The grep's positive control is the timestamped spelling, and the QA item's recipe signs with `signHttpBodyAt`. `Clause-②: no` (text only).

Container & model: `S`, `mode:subagent`, `model: CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` (`dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md …` at `efcbac73c`: MANDATORY — skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md ⇢ 'skills/**' — clause ① (2026-09-10 ruling, verbatim 「必须 fable的还包括对外发布的skills」); no exit taken)
Clause-②: no — teaching text, lint prose, an example comment and a QA recipe; the accept set of the inbound door is #22826's and is not touched here; `skills/**` is a governed rule-text face, so the at-tier contract review is owed and in seat.
Responsibility: `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md and four sender-facing texts, the five places ruling 6108492902 names | none — no gate reads the signature spelling these texts teach; the only reader is the author who copies it | every AI author and every custom integration that follows the published skill, the lint hint or the showcase comment to sign an inbound hook; today all five teach the replayable body-only form that #22826 will refuse`
Thread-read: 6108751309
Serial constraints cleared: one open PR touches one of the five paths — PR #22828 (the lint one-line-verdicts slice, in the merge queue at this read) changes `packages/lint/src/rule-explanations.ts`, so this PR is serial after it: the dev merges `origin/main` carrying #22828 before opening the PR, and the seat re-merges before landing if it has not landed by then; PR #22832 (#19939 pass 4 S2), #22794 and #22833 were diffed by name against the five and hit none (open PR list read 2026-10-11T12:33Z); `git ls-remote` shows no `claude/issue-22825-*` branch; #22585 (`pm:blocked` behind #19939) later edits the same `SKILL.md` and is serial after this PR; the lint files are the spec lane's and the showcase and checklist files the devx lane's, declared on their seat posts (#6017, #6023) this act under the exception path.
